look: Obsidian Maw Behemoth, a SS-rank GKOM variant from the Maw Behemoths family (FF Behemoth / King Behemoth, Diablo demonic beasts archetype reimagined for Adams Haven): gargantuan behemoth sealed in obsidian crystal, gravity distortion around its core. Family anatomy: massive horned quadruped calamity beasts with huge jaws and heavy clawed paws. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: sealed in GKOM crystal except its eyes, open mouth interior and core; the crystals are obsidian crystal. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, elaborate layered shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
